name: Data Factory in Microsoft Fabric
sku: The Data Factory workload of Microsoft Fabric on a Fabric capacity. The dbt job is marked preview on the deployment pipelines page and is not scored.

ingest.batch-extract.note: Connects to more than 170 data sources, including multicloud and on-premises through gateways. Copy job handles bulk and incremental copy, and Copy activity moves data at any scale with manual control of parallel copying.

ingest.cdc.note: Copy job offers change data capture replication as one of its delivery styles. Continuous database replication is done by Mirroring, which is scored separately.

orchestrate.dependency-dag.note: Pipelines run multiple data movements, transformations and other activities in one workflow, with loops and conditionals in a low-code designer. It also integrates Apache Airflow for orchestration as Python DAGs.

orchestrate.scheduling.note: Pipelines can be scheduled to run at specific times.

orchestrate.event-triggers.note: Pipelines can be triggered based on events as well as by schedule.

proposed_capabilities.name: Visual self-service data preparation
proposed_capabilities.description: Point-and-click combining, cleaning and shaping of data aimed at analysts, without writing SQL or Spark code. Dataflow Gen2 is a low-code interface with over 300 transformations for joins, aggregations and cleansing.

presentation.tagline: Copy, transform and orchestrate data inside Fabric, the next generation of Azure Data Factory.
